scraped.scraped_description: OpenOrigins ensures pixel-perfect authentication at the source, restoring believability in visual media.

name: OpenOrigins
tagline: The Trust Layer for a Verified Internet
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Proprietary technology stack; reliance on third-party data sources for verification

academic_citations.title: CoverDrop: Blowing the Whistle Through A News App
Content Authenticities: A Discussion on the Values of Provenance Data for Creatives and Their Audiences

curation_criteria: Proprietary verification algorithms; editorial standards for content assessment
political_relevance_summary: OpenOrigins addresses the erosion of trust in visual media by providing content authentication tools that help verify the provenance of images and video, combating deepfakes and manipulated content in political discourse.

movement_building_utility.notes: OpenOrigins primarily serves as an information resource for researchers, journalists, or analysts working on civic and political issues.

generalizability_notes: Moderate generalizability. OpenOrigins operates internationally but is proprietary, so replication would require licensing or rebuilding rather than direct adoption.
